message: Astra: Within Ya na’s investigation, what work does “deep breathing” do that the surrounding pressure statements do not? Have you tried the omission comparison yet, or is its effect still unknown? What would further thought clarify before an informative attempt, and what unresolved purpose could make waiting worthwhile? Which difference between versions would deserve your attention? Could you briefly state in English your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next intention, then carry out whichever step you judge useful?
